meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
India mein ₹3000 ke budget mein running aur daily workouts ke liye kai behtareen options available hain jo comfort aur durability dono provide karte hain.

The adidas Men Galaxy 7 Running Shoes feature a **Cloudfoam midsole** for maximum cushioning and a **breathable upper** to keep feet cool during daily runs.

The ASICS Jolt 4 Running Shoes For Men combine an **EVA midsole** with an **OrthoLite sockliner** for a soft, comfortable fit throughout the day.

The Puma Skyrocket Lite Men Unisex Running Shoes offer **great durability and traction** with a **comfortable mesh upper** designed for distance running.

The Nike Run Defy Men's Road Running Shoes provide a **foam midsole** and a **running-specific fit** well-suited for regular road training.

The Decathlon Running Shoes for Men JOGFLOW 100 are **lightweight and springy**, featuring **soft foam cushioning** designed specifically for beginner runners.

### Summary Recommendation

* **For Best All-Round Value:[top5bestpicks.com](https://top5bestpicks.com/best-running-shoes-under-3000-india-2026/#:~:text=4.0%2F5%20%2816.5K%29%20Best%20all-round%20value.)** Choose the **adidas Galaxy 7** for its trusted Cloudfoam cushioning.
* **For Long-lasting Step-in Comfort:** Go with the **ASICS Jolt 4** or **Puma Skyrocket Lite**.[in.puma.com](https://in.puma.com/in/en/shop/shoes-under-3000#:~:text=Filters%20*%20Product%20Type.%20*%20Activity%20Type.,Navy-PUMA%20Navy.%20%E2%82%B92%2C699%E2%82%B94%2C499.%20-40%25%20*%204%20Colors.)
* **For Beginners on a Budget:[top5bestpicks.com](https://top5bestpicks.com/best-running-shoes-under-3000-india-2026/#:~:text=Final%20Verdict.%20Overall%20pick%3A%20Adidas%20Drogo%20M,is%20not%20yet%20sure%20running%20will%20stick.)** The **Decathlon Jogflow 100** provides great shock absorption at a lower price point.

Agar aapko inme se kisi specific brand ya size ke options dekhne hain, toh aap bata sakte hain!
